opening.comment: The agent did not give their own name or the company name in the opening turn, so this criterion is not met.

verification.quote: Customer: ...My name is Niamh Willems, postcode a 2513 AA. Agent: Yes. Thank you, Niamh, matches your account.
verification.comment: The caller gave full name and postcode and the agent confirmed both against the account before proceeding.

understanding.quote: Agent: So the toaster arrived yesterday and doesn't turn on at all?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue (toaster not turning on after arrival) and did not ask for information already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: aisle refund the full €22.08 to your card, you'll see it within 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: For a faulty item the policy allows a free replacement or full refund paid within 5 working days, so the timeline is right, but the agent offered a refund without asking for a photo and the item is under EUR 25 so return is not needed, which the agent did say; the amount could not be verified from the call, and the agent's garbled wording makes the statement unclear.

process_compliance.comment: The agent did not ask for a photo before arranging the refund for a faulty item, a required step under the policy.

communication.quote: Agent: I'm sorry it doesn't work how of the box, that's disappointing.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and acknowledged the disappointment, though the customer's brief responses gave no clear frustration to address.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm next steps in full or ask if there was anything else, and ended the call abruptly.
